title: 第一卷 第75章 火焰使者
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“秦哥，你随便做，就算让我死，我也不会有什么话，我相信你，只要有在，就算发生什么不好的事情，你也会救我的。”

纣文慧根本没有考虑一秒。

其中，有成为附属木屋的缘故，更多的是对秦龙的无条件相信。

秦龙每每都能够创造奇迹，她都已经习惯了！

看到文慧对于自己如此的信任，秦龙更是有点犹豫不决。

“秦哥，我相信你，我也希望变得更强一点！”

看到秦龙这个样子，纣文慧上来抱住秦龙，语气更加坚定的说道。

好吧，再犹豫下去，自己倒是有点着想了。

“好，莉娅还没有醒来，今天的机会，先给你试试。”

秦龙说完，便没有犹豫，让文慧把衣物给脱了。

铭刻特性这种天赋，穿着衣服可不能行。

玩意铭刻到普通衣服上，那是白白浪费机会。

纣文慧闻言没有一丝犹豫，几下就把自己变成了原始状态。

秦龙不再犹豫！

铭刻成功！

当这个提示音响起的时候，秦龙狂喜！

这一刻，他仿佛看到了一条全新的道路！

特性：火焰使者，身体化为火的使者，天下各种火焰，都是如臂驱使，所有火焰攻击增加百分百威力，火焰掌控者！

金色的特性！

第一次铭刻成功就是S级金色特性！

“秦哥，我感觉好热！”

忽然纣文慧的声音传来！

刚才铭刻成功的时候，纣文慧有那么一瞬间失去了意识，紧接着又立马恢复了过来。

给自己的手下铭刻特性，貌似并没有什么伤害！

只是现在，文慧忽然感觉自己浑身很热。

没等秦龙说什么。

纣文慧原始状态的身体，忽然之间迸发出一股强大的热量。

身体在一瞬间变得通红无比，随着这种通红持续增加，到最后直接变成一种火红色。

接着这种火红色再也压抑不住，纣文慧瞬间变成了一个火人。

狂暴的高温，就连秦龙十一级的实力，都有点扛不住，忍不住往后退了两步。

“文慧，收敛心神，控制住你的火焰，这火焰是属于你的，控制！”

秦龙运转体内能量大喊。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Brother Qin, you can do whatever you want. Even if you let me die, I won't say anything. I believe in you. As long as you are here, you will save me even if something bad happens."

Zhou Wenhui didn't think about it for a second.

Among them, some are because of becoming an attached wooden house, and more are because of unconditional trust in Qin Long.

Qin Long can create miracles every time, and she is used to it!

Seeing Wen Hui trusting him so much, Qin Long was even more hesitant.

"Brother Qin, I believe in you, and I also hope to become stronger!"

Seeing Qin Long like this, Zhou Wenhui came up and hugged Qin Long, and said in a more firm tone.

Okay, if I continue to hesitate, I have some concerns.

"Okay, Leah hasn't woken up yet. I'll give you a try today."

After Qin Long finished speaking, he didn't hesitate and asked Wen Hui to take off his clothes.

The talent of imprinting characteristics cannot be achieved while wearing clothes.

It's a wasted opportunity if something is engraved on ordinary clothes.

Zhou Wenhui didn't hesitate at all after hearing this, and transformed himself into the original state in a few strokes.

Qin Long no longer hesitates!

Engraved success!

When the prompt sounded, Qin Long was ecstatic!

At this moment, he seemed to see a brand new path!

Characteristics: Flame Messenger, a messenger whose body turns into fire. All kinds of flames in the world are driven by arms. All flame attacks are 100% more powerful. Flame Controller!

Golden properties!

The first successful engraving is the S-class golden characteristic!

"Brother Qin, I feel so hot!"

Suddenly Zhou Wenhui's voice came!

When the inscription was successful just now, Zhou Wenhui lost consciousness for a moment, and then recovered immediately.

There doesn't seem to be any harm in engraving characteristics on your subordinates!

But now, Wen Hui suddenly felt hot all over.

Qin Long didn't wait for anything to say.

Zhou Wenhui's body in its original state suddenly burst out with a powerful heat.

The body became extremely red in an instant, and as the redness continued to increase, it finally turned into a fiery red.

Then the fiery red color could no longer be suppressed, and Zhou Wenhui instantly turned into a burning person.

Even Qin Long's eleventh level strength couldn't bear the violent heat and couldn't help but take two steps back.

"Wen Hui, calm down and control your flame. This flame belongs to you, control it!"

Qin Long shouted as he circulated the energy in his body.
